Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from the game. The ICC Women's T20 World Cup continues as we have a game lined up next between South Africa Women and Australia Women at 10.30 pm IST (5.00 pm GMT). Do switch tabs and enjoy the coverage of that game. Cheers!

Heather Knight the skipper of England Women says that the stand between her and Sciver was a key stand. Adds that Amy Jones was outstanding. They have a solid depth with the bat. Mentions to beat such a top side will certainly boost their confidence heading into the semis.

Harmanpreet Kaur the skipper of India Women says that they started off really well but they lost the momentum in the middle overs. Adds that they had a great start and Renuka was amazing. Says that they wanted to go with the flow and they just fell short of some runs. Ends by saying that they need to work on some areas and they will come back stronger.

Natalie Sciver wins the Player of the Match award for her exceptional outing with the blade. She says that it was tough early on. Praises Renuka Singh as she kept attacking the stumps. Says that it is always a good feeling when the shot comes off the middle of the bat. Adds they could not get a solid start with the blade. Lauds Amy Jones for her knock down the order. Mentions it is brilliant to play in front of the people who likes to see us play. The atmosphere has been electric throughout.
Presentations coming up...

Earlier in the match, England Women were reeling at 29/3 but Natalie Sciver, Heather Knight, and Amy Jones steadied the sinking ship for them. They made their team reach to a good total of 151 runs. Renuka Singh was the pick of the bowler of India Women as she picked up a fifer and ended her spell with excellent (4-0-15-5) figures.

A valiant effort from Richa Ghosh goes in vain. She made an excellent attempt at the very end but just couldn't get her team over the line. Smriti Mandhana was the only batter who stood firm from the start, the non-strikers kept on losing wickets. She was dismissed after scoring a fine 52 runs. Later, Richa Ghosh scored a quickfire 47 runs but it just wasn't enough.

An excellent game of cricket comes to an end and it is England Women who came out on top. They bowled really well throughout the innings and kept on picking up wickets at regular intervals. All of their bowlers were economical, baring the last over from Katherine Brunt. Sarah Glenn picked up two wickets which included a crucial wicket of Smriti Mandhana, and was certainly the pick of the bowlers for them.
Very full, wide of off. Richa Ghosh jams it out to cover. England Women win the match by 11 runs.
Bowls it on off, Richa Ghosh cuts it towards deep point for a brace.
SIX! All the way. Fuller and on off, Richa Ghosh hangs back and lofts it over long off for a maximum!
A full toss, on off, Pooja Vastrakar drills it to long on for one.
Fuller and on off, Richa Ghosh flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Another full toss on off, Richa Ghosh lofts it over mid off or another boundary. Oh, its a no ball for height. Free hit coming up...
FOUR! Poor delivery. A full toss, on off, Richa Ghosh slaps it over extra covers for a boundary!
Slightly shorter and on off, Richa Ghosh slaps it to point for one. 31 needed off the final over!
Fuller and on off, Pooja Vastrakar pushes it to covers for one.
Lands it on off, Pooja Vastrakar eases it to mid off.
Fuller and on off, Pooja Vastrakar flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.

OUT! RUN OUT! Short of a length into the pitch, Deepti heaves it away to the deep mid-wicket region for a risky second run. Replays show that Deepti is short of her ground. A run-out that aids England even more.

Tossed up, on off, Deepti Sharma looks to slog sweep it but misses it completely and gets a hit on her pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up. Deepti Sharma goes upstairs. The replay shows that there was a bat involved. NOT OUT!
Bowls it outside off, Richa Ghosh looks to scoop it but misses. 34 needed off 12 balls now!
Fuller and on midde, Richa Ghosh digs it to mid off. Dot.
SIX! All the way. Slower one again, outside off, Richa Ghosh picks it well and lofts it over long on for a biggie.
On a length and outside off, Richa Ghosh looks to slap it but misses.
Lands it outside off, Deepti Sharma slices it to deep covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Deepti Sharma heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller and on off, Deepti Sharma looks to loft it but edges it towards third man for a single.
On a length and on off, Deepti Sharma eases it to the cover fielder.
Shorter and on off, Deepti Sharma pulls it towards square leg for a brace.
Another one outside off, Deepti Sharma looks to play at it but misses again.
Lands it just outside off, Deepti Sharma looks to loft it but gets beaten.
Bowls it on middle, Deepti Sharma pulls it towards square leg for one.
Deepti Sharma walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sarah Glenn gets the big fish here and India Women are now in some trouble. Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana moves forward to loft it but mistimes it completely. It carries towards long on. Natalie Sciver settles under it and takes a sitter. Smriti Mandhana walks back after an excellent knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Natalie Sciver b Sarah Glenn

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! All the way. Smriti Mandhana gets her fifty in style. Fuller and outside off, Smriti Mandhana moves forward and lofts it over extra covers for a maximum! What a shot that is.
Fuller and on off, Richa Ghosh drives it to deep covers or one.
Another fuller one, Richa Ghosh slogs it over id-wicket for a brace.
Bowls it on off, Richa Ghosh slices it over point, and just over the fielder for a brace. Good attempt!
Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it to extra covers for one.
Bowls it down leg, Richa Ghosh looks to reverse sweep it but gets a bottom edge as the ball bounces off the deck. Dot.
Fuller and outside off, Smriti Mandhana slices it over extra covers for one.
Lands it on off, Richa Ghosh plays it uppishly towards deep extra covers for one.
Flighted up, on middle, Smriti Mandhana slogs it towards deep square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, Richa Ghosh cuts it towards point for one.
Bwols it on off, Richa Ghosh lofts it towards long on for a brace.
Lands it on middle, Richa Ghosh drives it to covers for one. India Women need 65 runs in 36 balls at 10.83 rpo now!
Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana lofts it down the ground. The fielder stops it just before the ropes. Excellent fielding. They cross.
Lands it outside off, Richa Ghosh cuts it to covers for one. The fielder has a shy at the bowlers end but misses.
Bowls it on middle, it skids through, Richa Ghosh looks to play at it but gets an inside edge onto her pads. Dot again.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Richa Ghosh looks to play at it but misses.
Bowls it on off, Richa Ghosh blocks it to point.
FOUR! Lands it on off, slower too, Smriti Mandhana moves forward and lofts it over extra covers for a boundary!
Lands it on leg, Smriti Mandhana eases it to the on side.
FOUR! Fine shot. Fuller and on middle and leg, Smriti Mandhana moves forward and caresses it through covers for a boundary. Much needed boundary for India Women!
Flighted up, on off, Richa Ghosh knocks it to long on for one.
Lands it on off, Richa Ghosh eases it back towards the bowler.
Fuller and on off, Richa Ghosh blocks it to covers.
Fuller and on leg, Richa Ghosh flicks it to backward square leg for one.
Wide! Lands it down leg, Richa Ghosh misses her flick.
FOUR MORE! Shorter and on off, Richa Ghosh pulls it through square leg for another boundary. Poor fielding in the deep.
FOUR! India Women need more of these. Errs her line and lands it down leg, Richa Ghosh uses the pace of the ball and tickles it through fine leg for a boundary!
Slightly shorter and on off, Richa Ghosh punches it to the cover fielder.
On a length, angling in, Richa Ghosh tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Bowls it on middle, Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards mid-wicket for one.
Lands it on leg, Smriti Mandhana flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it outside off, Smriti Mandhana taps it to covers.
Slightly shorter and on off, Richa Ghosh punches it to covers for one.
Flighted up, on off, Richa Ghosh eases it to mid off.
Richa Ghosh walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! Sophie Ecclestone gets the big fish here. Fuller and on off, it turns away further, Harmanpreet Kaur moves forward to loft it but mistimes it completely. It goes high up in the air towards covers. Alice Capsey settles under it and takes a good catch in her second attempt.
Commentary.Howout: c Alice Capsey b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur eases it to mid-wicket.
Kaur gets down on one knee and sweeps this to square leg for a single.
Shorter, on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it to deep mid-wicket. She plays with the turn here and gets a single.
Quicker and full, attacking the stumps. Kaur opens the face and works it to point for a single.
Short and on off. Kaur pushes it to cover.
Touch short, on leg. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it along the ground to deep square leg. The batters take two. Kaur is off the mark here.

Drinks! India Women are in a bit of trouble and have lost two wickets in the game. Smriti Mandhana is looking good in the middle and will look to continue in the same way. They need to move their gear up now. England Women will look for some quick wickets and get the game in their control. The skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A timely wicket for England Women. Sarah Glenn gets her first. Jemimah Rodrigues tries to break her shackles but holes out instead. It is pitched up, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues lofts it over the bowler's head but hits it straight down the throat of Katherine Brunt, who makes no mistake near the ropes.
Commentary.Howout: c Katherine Brunt b Sarah Glenn

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on the pads. Jemimah Rodrigues swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Overpitched, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues finds the fielder at cover with her drive.
It is floated and full, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues steps across and slashes it to deep point. The batters take two easily.
Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls this from outside off to deep mid-wicket. One taken.
Fuller and on the pads. Jemimah Rodrigues nudges it to sqare leg for a single.
On the pads, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple. These two keeping the runs ticking.
Jemimah Rodrigues gets low to this full ball and sweeps it through square leg for one.
A single now as this is worked to long on.
Full and on off. Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it behind square on the leg side for one.
Short and on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Dean does well in the deep to save a boundary with a late slide in. They take a single.

A chance goes down! Sophia Dunkley hands a new life to Smriti Mandhana. It is full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana comes down the track and looks to heave it away. The ball catches the outside edge and chips over cover. Sophia Dunkley tries to take a catch as the ball comes over her shoulder but it lands safely. Two taken.
Short ball, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues pulls it hard to deep mid-wicket. They only get one as there is protection in the deep.
Full and on leg. Jemimah Rodrigues gets low and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for one.
Fuller and outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans in and works it to right of long off. One taken.
A bit short, turning in sharply from outside off. Smriti Mandhana goes back and defends it to the off side.
Goes full, wide of off. Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and helps it to cover.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Smriti Mandhana defends it into the deck.
Floated and full, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to the left of mid off and crosses.
End of Powerplay! Sophie Ecclestone comes into the attack.
Slightly short, wide of off. Smriti Mandhana rides the bounce and cuts it through the gap at covers. They take before before the fielder cuts it off.
Full again, angled into the pads. Mandhana kncoks it towards mid on with soft hands.
Fuller and on middle. Smriti Mandhana eases it to mid on.
Beauty! It is a length ball, angled in from outside off. Smriti Mandhana makes a leave here. The ball is whisker away from the off pole.
Bell goes full, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues tries to drive it through the line. The ball catches the outside edge and runs down to third man for a single.
Good length, outside off. It climbs on the batter. Jemimah Rodrigues hangs back and cuts it to point.
WIDE! Bell errs in her line this time. This is on a length, outside off, shaping further away. Jemimah Rodrigues does not offer any shot. Wided.
Flatter and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Lands it on off, Jemimah Rodrigues eases it to covers.
Bowls it down leg, Jemimah Rodrigues eases it to square leg. Dot.
Wide! Angles it down leg, Jemimah Rodrigues lets it be.
Bowls it on off, Smriti Mandhana punches it to mid off for one.
Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana miscues her flick back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana greets Charlotte Dean with a boundary. Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Jemimah Rodrigues comes in at number 3. Also, Charlotte Dean comes into the attack for England Women.

OUT! TAKEN! A much-needed breakthrough for England Women in the game. Shorter and on off, Shafali Verma moves forward to loft it but mistimes it completely. It goes in the air towards long on. Katherine Brunt settles under it and takes a sitter. Shafali Verma makes her way back into the shed.
Commentary.Howout: c Katherine Brunt b Lauren Bell

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on off, Shafali Verma guides it to the fielder at point. Good over so far!
Fuller and outside off, Shafali Verma plays it uppishly towards point. It carries for a bit and lands just short of the fielder. Excellent try!
Shorter and outside off, Shafali Verma drills it but finds the fielder at mid on.
On a length and down leg, Shafali Verma eases it to leg gully.
Fuller and outside off, Shafali Verma guides it towards deep backward point for a brace.
On a length and on off, Smriti Mandhana blocks it back. 16 off the over!
FOUR! My oh my. This is not good for England Women. Slightly shorter and on middle, Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary!
Shorter and outside off, Smriti Mandhana offers no stroke.
FOUR! Three in a row. Lands it shorter and on off, Smriti Mandhana pulls it over mid-wicket for four more.
FOUR MORE! Fuller and on off, slower too, Smriti Mandhana drills it through long off for another boundary!
FOUR! Fine shot. On a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana rocks back and cuts it through covers for a boundary!
Bowls it outside off, Smriti Mandhana slices it over backward point for one. She will keep the strike for the next over.
Lands it on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it but finds the fielder at extra covers again.
Shorter and on middle, Shafali Verma pulls it towards mid-wicket for one.
Slower and outside off, Shafali Verma lets it go.
FOUR! Fine shot. Fuller and outside off, Shafali Verma opens the face of the bat and guides it through backward point for a boundary!
On a length, angling in, Shafali Verma looks to drive it but misses.
Wide! Lands it down leg, Shafali Verma misses her flick.
Lauren Bell to bowl from the other end.
Fuller and outside off, Smriti Mandhana drives it towards the fielder at extra covers again.
Slightly shorter and on off, Smriti Mandhana punches it to covers. Dot again.
Wide! Shorter and down leg, Smriti Mandhana ducks under it.
Another fuller, on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it but finds the fielder at covers again.
Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it but finds the fielder at extra covers.
Lands it on middle, Shafali Verma tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Wide! Lands it down leg, Shafali Verma looks to flick it but misses.
On a length and on middle, Smriti Mandhana pulls it to square leg and gets off the mark. Single taken.
